description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule update functionalities, including various scenarios such as recursive updates, shallow clones, handling of symlinks, and configuration options. It contains setup routines, multiple test cases, and validation steps to ensure correct behavior of submodule management commands.

methods.name: compare_head
methods.description: Compares the SHA of the main branch HEAD and the submodule HEAD to check if they are at the same commit.

methods.name: add_submodule_commit_and_validate
methods.description: Creates a new submodule, stages it, commits, and validates the staged commit matches the actual submodule state.
